## Walkthrough

The Interpreter class undergoes internal state refactoring: a new `DjumpStatus` enum and reusable `DjumpResult`/`BranchResult` classes are introduced as private instance fields. Duplicate class definitions previously scattered in the file are consolidated near the top. The biome configuration schema is updated to version 2.3.6.

## Changes

| Cohort / File(s) | Change Summary |
|---|---|
| **Interpreter state refactoring** <br> `assembly/interpreter.ts` | Introduces `DjumpStatus` enum (OK, HALT, PANIC); adds unmanaged `DjumpResult` and `BranchResult` classes; consolidates four private state fields (`djumpRes`, `argsRes`, `outcomeRes`, `branchRes`) with lint-ignore annotations; removes duplicate class definitions from later in file; preserves existing jump handling logic. |
| **Configuration schema update** <br> `biome.jsonc` | Updates `$schema` reference from 2.2.6 to 2.3.6. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes

- Verify `DjumpStatus` enum values are correctly utilized in jump handling logic
- Confirm `DjumpResult` and `BranchResult` class initialization and field access patterns
- Check that lint-ignore annotations are justified for the unused private members
- Ensure consolidation of duplicate definitions doesn't introduce unintended state sharing
